verdict.rationale: First-party docs repeatedly claim 10,000+ tools across 3,000+ APIs, and a probe of the live llms.txt app marketplace lists 3,223 apps. Each app gets a dedicated MCP server, per-app pages (ClickUp, OpenAI with 46 actions and 4 triggers) show real catalog depth, and a proxy covers endpoints that have no pre-built tool. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of catalog breadth and per-integration tool quality beyond first-party listings.
